items.quote: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
items.claim: The construction of the tabernacle was completed by the children of Israel following the LORD's commands delivered through Moses.
items.actor: children of Israel; the LORD; Moses
items.action: finished the work; did according to commands
items.object: tabernacle of the tent of the congregation
items.mechanism: following all that the LORD commanded Moses
